title: MxAgile Project Configuration
description: Project-level MxAgile configuration. Agents read mxagile-project.yaml in the project root to determine UI-driven mode, concern-specific source authority, fidelity requirements, and runtime strategy. If the file is absent all defaults apply and existing MxAgile behavior is preserved.

ui_driven.description: When true the mockup is the authoritative delivery reference for configured UI concerns. Discovery must find and process all HTML mockups. Implementation follows the UI inventory as a binding contract. Verification enforces fidelity.

runtime.description: Runtime strategy configuration. Controls which mechanism is preferred for formal verification (Verifying phase). Defaults reflect local-first development. See policies/runtime-strategy.md for the full escalation model.

verification.description: local_first (default): prefer warm local runtime (mxcli run --local --watch, Level 3) for formal verification; escalate to Docker (Level 4) only when container-parity is required or local runtime cannot provide valid evidence. docker: always use Docker for formal verification (for projects requiring container parity or migrating gradually from legacy behavior). Existing projects without this field receive local_first behavior.

source_authority.description: Per-concern source authority. Each concern is resolved independently; a source does not globally override another source. Only conflicts within the same concern and no configured winner produce DECISION REQUIRED.

ui_interaction.description: Interaction behavior: field behaviour, button enablement, visible state transitions.

business_logic.description: Business rules, mandatory field semantics, calculations, status transitions.

data_rules.description: Data types, constraints, validation rules, entity definitions.

fidelity.description: standard: UI-Agent Verify checks structural field/button presence. high: additionally verifies semantic layout (section grouping, element ordering, component types, navigation flows, interaction states, visual hierarchy).

prerequisites.description: Project-level prerequisite and credential bootstrap configuration. MxAgile Core uses this to know which credential categories are required, which canonical source provides them, and how to validate readiness. Company Layers may extend this via .mxagile/layers/<id>/credentials.yml. See policies/credential-discovery.md for the full contract.

credential_source.description: Canonical local secret file for this project. Default: .env.mendix (gitignored). MxAgile Core discovers and validates this file before any runtime start.

mock_data.description: Mock/seed data configuration for UI-driven scenarios.

bootstrap_script.description: Path to seed/bootstrap script that initializes representative test data. Run automatically before browser verification when present.

idempotent.description: When true, the bootstrap script can be safely re-run without duplicating data.

require_browser_evidence_for_discovery.description: When true (default) and development.ui_driven=true, Full UI Discovery PASS requires browser-level evidence for runtime-testable scope. Set to false to allow model-only discovery to satisfy the gate (not recommended for ui_driven projects).
